data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Phase-gate file location resolution rule — gate function looks up files via: (1) $RECONCILER_PHASE_GATE_DIR if set, else (2) $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.reconciler-state/. Documented in audit_dd4_phase_gate.sh header schema block. Add RED test: gate function honors RECONCILER_PHASE_GATE_DIR env-var override (set to /tmp/test-gate; create gate file there; check_phase_gate finds it). Rationale: 5 consumer scripts (dd1/dd2/dd3/dd5 + Makefile) — missing resolution contract guarantees integration drift (implicit_assumption).
